{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''A Toss of the Dice: This Gambler's Life''''' was a memoir written by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. In it, he described his experiences being taken to the center of [[Rafa V]] after entering a [[Sharu/Legends|Sharu]] pyramid, and being shown the complete history of the Sharu, from their origins as single-celled organisms to their state at the time of his journey. He also speculated in this memoir that the historical gallery might have still existed.<ref name="THH">{{GamerCite|5|The Hutt Hit}}</ref>
